widget_values_sig:
"-------------------------------
The General Process
-------------------------------

- Phase 1: Initial Draft -

In the Configuration node, enable Draft Output and Main Sampling Pass (and AutoCFG, recommended). Set your Music Tags and your Lyrics. Change the seed to generate something new, and generate until you get something you like aesthetically. Be sure to set the song duration to something reasonable depending on the length of your lyrics.

For the following phases, make sure you keep the same seed!



- Phase 2: Perfect Lyrics -

Turn on the Audio 2 Audio and Retake options, then load the audio you decided on from the first phase using the Load Audio node. For sections you want to redo, set the Retake Start and Retake End. Remember, these are in seconds (60 seconds to a minute); if you want to start at 2:21 and redo 10 seconds, that's 141.0 to 151.0. These numbers are approximate and should be tweaked.

You can change the 'Remix Amount' in the Audio 2 Audio group depending on the 'strength' of the change you need.

Generate retakes until you perfect the lines. Once you've got one right, reload the audio with the new file, and repeat until you've fixed them all.



- Phase 3: Resample -

Turn off Retake. You probably want to turn off Main Sampling Pass as well, or else you'll actually be making a remix.

Turn on the Enable Upscaled Output and Enable Split and Resample. Also enable Vocals and Background Normalizers if you want to control the volume (recommended). There are several values you can tweak (vocal upsampling, volume normalization, etc.) to control the results.



- Optional Phase 4: Remix!

If you turn on Main Sampling Pass on with Audio 2 Audio, you'll be remixing the original audio you loaded! You might want to turn off other options (like Enable Upscaled Output, Enable Split and Resample, Vocals and Background Normalizers) until you are satisfied, then do a final resample as in Phase 3. This helps keep the audio quality optimal."

"[solo]

[verse]
Makin' lyrics, they're so fun
I didn't think about these a ton
I wrote these lyrics when I was high
before I sellout I'd rather die

[chorus]
It's best to put these lyrics
into sections of four.
Or else you'll be in hysterics
and wondering if there's more

[verse]
So you see, my lyrics are awful
but if you sing 'em it's not unlawful
because it's all open source,
you can copy them without remorse!

[chorus]
It's best to put these lyrics
into sections of four.
Or else you'll be in hysterics
and wondering if there's more

[verse]
So take these lyrics, and test away
hope your song comes out okay
If it doesn't, I'm not at fault
Launch you out of a catapult

[chorus]
It's best to put these lyrics
into sections of four.
Or else you'll be in hysterics
and wondering if there's more

[outro]
I hope the song came out fine.
We'll make another one one more time
Don't worry, next one will be great
And if not, it's probably too late"
